propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, clone/strip driver, pure metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main because the live LLM batch was rejected.

The ~450-run live gate replay batch (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise ~50-ticket×3 candidate/current pairs with fresh runs) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder on main (change #798), which accumulates the same verdict-perturbation signal at zero marginal LLM cost from production reviews.

The replay design removes recall contamination via REVIEW_RESULT-strip on a cloned store and baseline drift via material-fingerprint guards and fresh-both-gates two-level-median pairing (candidate vs current, with current-vs-current null floor).

History-mining of plan-v3 baselines is dead: only ~4 sidecar baselines exist against the ~200 needed (impact_model_version bump stranded the history), making live replay the only viable signal source but unjustifiable by cost.

R1 gate false-positive bar requires ≤3/30 new blocking findings and median advisory delta ≤1 on cleanly-closed sample (post_claim_edit_class==none, reopen_count==0, force_close==false) plus ≤2% PASS→BLOCK flip rate on wider sample.
